records.name: Arestol
records.name_string_id_reason: The guide lists multiple locale-table name IDs; see name_string_ids.
title_or_role: The Academy's record keeper and historian: "Talk to Arestol, Shrouded Glade's record keeper" (2789959025); "Arestol is still the historian in Shrouded Glade" (2742813247).
location_evidence: At the Druid Academy ("Return the missing books to Arestol at the Druid Academy." 2898765982). Video: nameplate beside Suni Sorrowsmile, Misty Mountain marker 92 m (T1Gie2A5nEE/00024).
quests_given_text: Missing library books ("Several books have gone missing from the Druid Academy's library recently. Arestol would like for you to search Shrouded Glade and find them." 684372761; "Return to Arestol in Shrouded Glade" 1864515453); buried tomes on Misty Mountain ("Arestol will reward you if you can find some buried tomes up on Misty Mountain" 794019279; book on Fastvi Frostflutter from "the highest peak of Misty Mountain", 1308263417); the Warrior's Tome ("Return the Warrior's Tome to Arestol in Shrouded Glade." 2620663095; he sends the player on to Iris Shiversting above Snowhill, 1930645234) in Warrior: Finding Facts About Fastvi (matched by wording on that page, W15); holds the notes on ice magic that Suni and Keldon want (808705770, 4120808893). records.name: Captain Sunspark
records.name_string_id_reason: The guide lists multiple locale-table name IDs; see name_string_ids.
title_or_role: Royal Guard captain, Shrouded Glade veteran
Royal Guard captain who sends the player to help the druids or the dwarves. Row on NPCs - Sanctuary.
location_evidence: Sanctuary is his post by the wiki (Sanctuary and Shrouded Glade categories) and by the Job Center line (3440602433), but no client text says where in Sanctuary he stands. "By the warpstone" (1920312839, 4240645652) is the Shrouded Glade warpstone, see Conflicts 15. Shrouded Glade: 1258768097, 582855445; wiki puts him "in front of the Warpstone in Shrouded Glade" (NPCs - Shrouded Glade)
"In front of the Warpstone in Shrouded Glade" (wiki Quest:Trapped and Alone). "Report to Captain Sunspark by the warpstone" (1920312839, 4240645652): see Conflicts 8.
quests_given_text: Visiting the Job Center (finish: "speak to Captain Sunspark", 3440602433); Report to Sunspark; Seaside Report; Payback; Backs Against the Wall; Trapped and Alone; This Glade is Ours!; The Way of the Wilds (client titles; Heroes Journal chapters); Troubling Waters (wiki only, no client title)

Backs Against the Wall / Trapped and Alone (the choice: "Captain Sunspark in Shrouded Glade has sent you to help the druids." 2551761769; "...help the dwarves." 1258768097), Report to Sunspark (2226786156), Payback, and the finale "This Glade is Ours!" ("Join Captain Sunspark for the final attack against the Gloam in Shrouded Glade." 3171990650). Also NPCs - Sanctuary for the rest of his chapters.

records.name: Ceard Bauchlog
records.name_string_id_reason: The guide lists multiple locale-table name IDs; see name_string_ids.
title_or_role: Druid Elder ("our druid Elder, Ceard Bauchlog", 2277251266; "Elder Ceard Bauchlog", 1367967653). He secretly buys potions to keep the weakened Arch Druid alive: "I'm not blind to what's going on here. I know he's trying to keep the Arch Druid from withering away." (4259647923, speaker not named). Wiki Timeline: Ceard "has been quietly providing potions to keep Camillia strong so the other druids will not suspect" (wiki spells her Camillia).
location_evidence: "To the right of the Druid Academy in Shrouded Glade." (195933183). Not in video.
quests_given_text: The potion and flower chain (see #Quest index): Potions for the Arch Druid ("Ceard wants you to get a potion from Perci in Shrouded Glade." 1497227789; "Acquire a potion from Perci in Shrouded Glade for Ceard Bauchlog." 1704034030; "Deliver the potion to Ceard Bauchlog" 866291283); receives Edvard's rare flower ("Deliver the rare flower to Elder Ceard Bauchlog in Shrouded Glade." 1367967653); Power stones from Mugwort's Hollow ("Retrieve power stones from Mugwort's Hollow for Ceard Bauchlog." 1454045340; "The power stones can be found within Mugwort's Hollow to the west of Shrouded Glade." 4097395734; dungeon Mugwort's Hollow); Lumber scouting (2239618292; scouts the area west of the Blackspore warpstone and near Farmer Brambleback's farm in Briarwood); Clear the Misty Mountain path ("Some nasty critters are blocking the path through Misty Mountain that the druids of Shrouded Glade use to perform their rites." 3536529370; dungeon Misty Mountain). A recommendation line: "Ceard Bauchlog recognizes your potential, and recommends that you offer your services to Queen Valerian." (4208462784).

records.name: Dorn Geargrinder
records.name_string_id_reason: The guide lists multiple locale-table name IDs; see name_string_ids.
title_or_role: Gus's brother, co-leader and successor.
Co-leader of the Freewheelers per the wiki; the client calls him "the new leader of the Freewheelers, now that his brother Gus is gone" (1734286197). Hero of the Sunstone line.
location_evidence: Dwarf camp (video nameplate ct2JrtOiO4g/00444, /00496, /00500, /00654). Later in Rumble Ridge, Sunstone Valley.

Rumble Ridge (wiki "Speak with Dorn Geargrinder located in Rumble Ridge"). [video: a green marker 35 to 99 m away while the Abandoned Mine banner, the "Sunstone Valley Approach" label and Sunstone Copper Veins are on screen (fMOGHMuA2Hc/00068, /00046, /00056); 102 m from Wheelie Pete in /00128]. During the Gloam invasion he stands in the dwarf camp in Shrouded Glade [video ct2JrtOiO4g/00444, /00654].

Gus tells new helpers to "go hassle my brother Dorn" (906376126). Full table below.

records.name: Edvard Leafsnipper
records.name_string_id_reason: The guide lists multiple locale-table name IDs; see name_string_ids.
title_or_role: Gardener of the Academy. Wiki: "wanders around the Gardener's Hutch, talking and tending to all his lovely plants, while Delia stands to the side and observes." He grows the rare flower for the Arch Druid (3168642161) and mentions her illness (865637754).
location_evidence: The Gardener's Hutch ("Edvard is tending to plant life at the Gardner's Hutch." 2307488951; "Speak to Edvard Leafsnipper at the Gardener's Hutch." 3413491354). Video: nameplate next to Emil Jadefish and the round tree house (EkNbw2nCVQc/00012, /00014, /00016, /00018); RbRv_A5daaQ/00212, /00230 (distance marker) beside a wooden water tower.
quests_given_text: Edvard's gardening: missing tools (484860584; shovels 853289627, watering buckets 1160798607, fertilizer bags 1246254551, gardening picks 3794212657, "Return the missing garden tools to Edvard Leafsnipper at the Gardener's Hutch." 1480660843); fertilizer ("Edvard makes his own special blend of fertilizer ... harvest sunleaf, punkin, and rainleaf." 1191354260; "Edvard would like for you to add the fertilizer to potted ferns around Shrouded Glade." 3346727576; 275780311 "yellow potted ferns"); a well-water planting task (2268351299). The post-invasion helper line: "Things have been difficult since the invasion. The lights are still acting up, and Edvard the gardener has been having trouble regrowing his plants." (3115356372). Items "Edvard's Fertilizer" (763047425), "Edvard's Shovel" (3688564881), "Edvard's Gardening Pick" (556949301). Rare flower to Ceard (3168642161).
records.quests_accepted_reason: No explicit quoted hand-in to this NPC was isolated; full guide quest text remains in quests_given_text.
records.vendor_stock_reason: The page provides no vendor stock for this NPC.
services: Provides the flower, tools and fertilizer for his quests.

records.name: Headmaster Merk
records.name_string_id_reason: The guide lists multiple locale-table name IDs; see name_string_ids.
title_or_role: Head of the Academy and druid war leader.
Druid headmaster from Shrouded Glade who moves to Rumble Ridge to help the dwarves.
location_evidence: "Down the path past the warpstone. He's right in front of the druid refuge cave." (384305230). Video: nameplate beside General Drahk (ct2JrtOiO4g/00318, /00400, /00406, /00436). After the event he goes to Sunstone Valley to help the dwarves (658173465).

Shrouded Glade first: "down the path past the warpstone ... right in front of the druid refuge cave" (384305230). The wiki's Sunstone quests put him in Rumble Ridge ("Speak with Headmaster Merk located in Rumble Ridge"); a Shrouded Glade line says "Merk went to help the dwarves in Sunstone Valley" (658173465). [video: nameplate and chat speaker in the Shrouded Glade fight, ct2JrtOiO4g/00318, /00400, /00406, /00436; no Sunstone frame]

location_evidence: Not stated directly. His fishing bait is the "stink" in the Shrouded Glade water, traced to "an icy area within Snowhill" (1784862177); his reply: "Is it really causing that big of a stink? ... I'll try some different bait" (348248045, speaker inferred), and the Embir errand names him (1593063336). Placed in Snowhill because of Big J and that icy area; his exact spot is unknown. No video, no wiki page.

Text-to-title pairing is by wording. Target of the water-stink errand in NPCs - Shrouded Glade ("Let Embir know that Little J's fishing bait is causing the smell" 1593063336). A flier hand-in ("Give a flier to Little J" 3101422509) is probably a Postman delivery, unproven.
